name: bookstore-fullstack
description: Full-stack bookstore application with React frontend, Express backend, and React admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:front" "npm run start:back" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.start:front: cd front && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.start:admin: cd admin && npm run build && serve -s build -l 3001
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd front && npm install && cd ../back && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.clean: cd front && npm run build && cd ../back && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build
